DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia (ALL).

The combination of severe bone pain, fever, easy bruising (thrombocytopenia), and a blood smear showing immature lymphoid cells (CD10, CD19, TdT positive) confirms this diagnosis. We will proceed with immediate oncology consultation and further staging imaging.
